streets.name: Calle Pintor Picasso
streets.trust: Google standard map, satellite imagery and walking-route cross-check, 12 October 2026; local alignment and widths approximate (roughly 1–2 m reference precision); 24 Nov 2026: the whole stretch along the car park, to the wall's south end, moved onto a line 3.1 m east of the long wall's centreline, so the 6 m asphalt meets the wall foot as IMG_3125 and IMG_3129 show (estimated, data/picasso_car_park.json). The aerial puts the cypress hedge 7-8 m from the wall; street width is one value for the whole street, and 7.5 m would cut the photographed service-road ramp further south, so the 1-2 m strip towards the hedge is a known shortfall 26 Nov 2026 (task picasso-service-road-levels-and-beach; Dave circled the road on to the beach): continued past the hotel's low block, round its corner and across the forecourt by the pool building, to (3.5, 70.0) where it narrows into the lane to the paseo (street picasso-beach-lane), on the pale road surface of the Esri aerial between the registry buildings either side, about 1-1.5 m (IMG_3118, IMG_3119, IMG_3105, IMG_3106).

streets.name: Calle Pintor Picasso
streets.trust: 26 Nov 2026: the seaward end of Calle Pintor Picasso, the service lane between the pool building's sheds and the big-pool lawn wall on the west and the long eaved building (registry 6465801UF1366N parts 1-3) on the east, from the forecourt at (3.5, 70.0) to the drain grate at the paseo's edge, (27.9, 95.75). The faces either side stand 9.5 m apart at the north end and 5.3 m at the mouth (aerial, about 1 m). IMG_2613 and IMG_3067 show a kerbed concrete footway about 1.2-1.5 m wide along the west walls and the roadway, about 3.5 m, from its kerb to the terrace wall; so the ribbon is 3.2 m (the walls stand only 4.7 m apart face to face near the mouth, leaving room for the 1.3 m footway), shifted 0.6-0.75 m east of the midline from about z 80, and ends at the grate (the red paseo paving runs up to it). Levels from the laser survey: -1.44 m at the forecourt falling to about -1.95 m at the grate. Independent review 26 Nov 2026.

streets.name: Calle de Picasso
streets.trust: 25 Nov 2026 (Dave: this is Calle Picasso): the footpath along the main car park's west side, behind the hedge strip at the back of the west bays, from the CALLE DE PICASSO plinth and lantern where it meets the Juan Gris paving (IMG_3131) to the end of Calle Eva. The Esri aerial, straightened along the west bay row, shows a pale tiled band 8.4 m west of the bays' car line (brightness and colour profiles every 3 m, straight to 0.45 m rms), about 1.5-2 m wide, between the house garden walls and the green hedge strip; Google's standard map labels this line C. Pintor Picasso (reference/google-maps/01). Width 1.8 m estimated. Its last 9 m to Calle Eva follow the old map line. Levels from the laser survey: three level stretches (+1.17, +0.71 and +0.20 m) joined by two flights of steps beside a ramp (data/picasso_path_steps.json). Not photographed between the plinth and Calle Eva. Earlier this id was a 4 m asphalt 'car-park access' line from Google's map, about 2 m east of the path.
